about: Eval set for the AI program review (scripts/run_eval.py). Each case is a lifter profile plus automatic expectations. 'address' = exercises the review should change (swap, remove, sets, reps or effort on their slots) because of the injury; 'lower_volume' = muscles whose week-1 volume should drop; 'max_edits' = more than this means over-editing.

cases.about: Beginner, 3 days, full gym, nothing special: the standard plan should mostly stand.
Overhead pressing hurts: the overhead press should be changed.

profile.injuries: left shoulder hurts on overhead pressing
